Teaching and Learning
Postgraduate Studies
The LKS Faculty of Medicine (HKUMed) is a hub of innovative and multidisciplinary research, and we take great pride in fostering a collaborative environment that encourages breakthrough discoveries through its teaching schools and departments as well as research centres, institutes and units, including (but not limited to):
School of Biomedical Sciences
School of Biomedical Engineering
School of Chinese Medicine
School of Clinical Medicine
Departments of:
Anaesthesiology, Clinical Oncology, Diagnostic Radiology, Emergency Medicine, Family Medicine & Primary Care, Medicine, Microbiology, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopaedics & Traumatology, Paediatrics & Adolescent Medicine, Pathology, Psychiatry, Surgery
Centre of Cancer Medicine, Medical Ethics & Humanities Unit
School of Nursing
School of Public Health
Department of Pharmacology and Pharmacy
Bau Institute of Medical and Health Sciences Education
With access to state-of-the-art facilities and a diverse array of research areas, our students acquire the skills and expertise to become research leaders and make impactful contributions in their fields and beyond. Discover how to embark on your postgraduate journey today and dive into endless possibilities at HKUMed!
Get Your Hands on the Latest Pamphlet
Developing Partnerships and Deploying Cutting-edge Technology
Professor Rubén Hervas Millan has forged impactful collaborations and helped establish one of Hong Kong's leading cryo-electron microscopy labs at HKUMed. Discover how HKUMed empowers researchers to drive innovation!
Why HKUMed?
1st in Hong Kong
2nd in Asia
18th in the World
(Quacquarelli Symonds World University Rankings in Life Sciences & Medicine 2026 / Times Higher Education World University Rankings in Medical & Health 2026)
140 years of medical education excellence
89 Researchers among the world's top 1% scholars (ESI)
537 Highly Cited Papers (Clarivate)
27 Highly Cited Researchers (Clarivate)
Research Areas & Available Projects
Cancer
Stem Cell & Regenerative Medicine
Inflammation & Immunology
Artificial Intelligence/ Data Science/ Biomedical Engineering
Public Health
Infectious Diseases
And many more…
Growing Collaboration with Mainland China and Exploring Translational Research
Professor Ralf Jauch's research at HKUMed thrives on strong ties with mainland China. These connections open doors to one of the world's largest research landscapes, offering valuable networks and smooth career paths across Hong Kong, mainland China, and beyond!
